subject: In mice, removing brain immune cells restored two hours of sleep
script: From Agewell Brief: In mice, removing brain immune cells restored two hours of sleep. An experiment in mice has separated two features of Alzheimer’s disease that are often treated as one problem. Amyloid plaques remained in place, yet sleep improved sharply when researchers removed most of the brain’s microglia—the immune cells that react to those plaques. Read the full source-linked dispatch and primary study caveats at AgewellBrief.com.
